mapper.select: SELECT t.*, z.zhmc FROM bgxt_tsxmtat t LEFT JOIN bgxt_xmzh_zb z ON t.zhid=z.zhid ORDER BY t.sb_djid, t.syqk
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bgxt_tsxmtat (sb_djid, brlb, syqk, zhid, zhmc, TAT) VALUES (#{sbDjid}, #{brlb}, #{syqk}, #{zhid}, #{zhmc}, #{tat}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE TAT=#{tat}, zhmc=#{zhmc}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM bgxt_tsxmtat WHERE sb_djid=#{sbDjid} AND brlb=#{brlb} AND syqk=#{syqk} AND zhid=#{zhid}
mapper.update: UPDATE bgxt_xmzh_zb SET ddsj = (SELECT AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, b.srrq, b.shrq)) + #{buffer} FROM bgxt_brxx b JOIN bgxt_his_xm hx ON b.brxx_id = hx.brxx_id WHERE hx.zhid = bgxt_xmzh_zb.zhid AND b.ybzt IN (2,3) AND b.shrq IS NOT NULL AND b.jyrq >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)) WHERE 1=1

UPDATE bgxt_xmzh_zb SET ddsj = (SELECT AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, b.srrq, b.shrq)) + #{buffer} FROM bgxt_brxx b JOIN bgxt_his_xm hx ON b.brxx_id = hx.brxx_id WHERE hx.zhid = bgxt_xmzh_zb.zhid AND b.ybzt IN (2,3) AND b.shrq IS NOT NULL AND b.jyrq >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)) WHERE bgxt_xmzh_zb.zhid IN (SELECT zhid FROM bgxt_yqxmzh WHERE sb_djid = #{sbDjid})
